people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Amminadab
people.line: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

people.name: Nadab
people.line: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.

people.name: Nahshon
people.line: Son of Amminadab, leader of Judah, ancestor of David.

translations.web: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
translations.bsb: And Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
translations.kjv: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
